scenes.title: How attention works
scenes.narration: Read the sentence: the animal crossed the street because it was tired. To interpret it, you connect that word back to animal. Self-attention gives a model a way to learn connections like this. Each token gathers information from other tokens, with different weights for different relationships.

scenes.title: Queries, keys & values
scenes.narration: Each token produces a query, a key, and a value. The query is compared with the keys to score possible connections. Softmax turns those scores into weights that add up to one. A weighted sum of the values gives the token its new representation.

scenes.title: Many heads, one layer
scenes.narration: A single set of weights gives one view of a sentence. The Transformer runs several attention heads in parallel, each with its own learned projections. It concatenates their outputs and mixes them with a learned matrix, so one token can incorporate several kinds of information.

scenes.title: What changed
scenes.narration: Earlier recurrent translation models processed a sentence one position at a time. The Transformer encoder computes representations for all positions in a layer together. In the paper's English-to-German translation experiment, the model reached 28.4 BLEU. The decoder still generates translated words one at a time.

paper.title: Attention Is All You Need
sections: Read the sentence: the animal crossed the street because it was tired. To interpret it, you connect that word back to animal. Self-attention gives a model a way to learn connections like this. Each token gathers information from other tokens, with different weights for different relationships.

Each token produces a query, a key, and a value. The query is compared with the keys to score possible connections. Softmax turns those scores into weights that add up to one. A weighted sum of the values gives the token its new representation.

A single set of weights gives one view of a sentence. The Transformer runs several attention heads in parallel, each with its own learned projections. It concatenates their outputs and mixes them with a learned matrix, so one token can incorporate several kinds of information.

Earlier recurrent translation models processed a sentence one position at a time. The Transformer encoder computes representations for all positions in a layer together. In the paper's English-to-German translation experiment, the model reached 28.4 BLEU. The decoder still generates translated words one at a time.
